name: codex-ubuntu-notifications
description: Desktop completion notifications, optional answer previews and audio for local Codex workspaces on Ubuntu, with dependency diagnostics.

commands.title: Codex Ubuntu Notifications: Send Test Notification
Codex Ubuntu Notifications: Import Custom Sound File

codexNotifier.enabled.description: Enable notifications when Codex finishes answering a turn.

codexNotifier.mode.description: When to notify: 'always' (even when VS Code is focused) or 'unfocused' (only when VS Code is in the background).

codexNotifier.desktopNotification.description: Show an Ubuntu desktop notification (via notify-send) when Codex finishes.

codexNotifier.previewCard.description: Show an optional answer preview using GTK3 on X11/XWayland. Falls back to a native notification when unavailable.

codexNotifier.previewDuration.description: How many seconds the bottom-left answer preview card remains visible (3-20).

codexNotifier.sound.description: Play completion audio via available PipeWire, PulseAudio or ALSA backends.

codexNotifier.soundChoice.description: Selected sound preset or imported custom sound filename.

codexNotifier.vscodeToast.description: Also show an in-editor VS Code information toast notification.

codexNotifier.codexHome.description: Absolute path to the local Codex home. Empty uses CODEX_HOME, then ~/.codex. Only the documented database schema is supported.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Local Codex databases and desktop processes require a trusted workspace.

scripts.test: node scripts/run-tests.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s test -p "test_*.py"
